structural_review.notes: Triangle mode, valid GLB length, UVs and embedded 1024px base colour checked. Requested targets are approximate; actual triangle count and target deviations are reported separately, within the user-specified 3000-prop / 8000-character ceilings. Scale, pivot, topology and visual quality require separate review.

visual_review.notes: Complete bare-headed farmer, correct navy/cream/brown palette, two separated arms/hands and legs/boots; no hat, tools or extra anatomy. Rear clothing clean. Broad painted colour blocking preserved, with softer small brush detail than source. Normalized 1.6m tall, feet at Y=0, facing +Z.

import_review.notes: Real scene vertices and indices decoded; finite positions/UVs; retained embedded 1024px base colour. Uniform root transform; raw file preserved.

assembly_review.notes: Static actual-geometry fit checked from front, rear/opposite, side, three-quarter and high angles. Socket frames use metres/+Y up/+Z forward. No reflections or nonuniform scale.
